# No addons?
WoW Classic WoW Classic Hardcore
[Trialsin-1612608](https://us.forums.blizzard.com/en/wow/u/Trialsin-1612608) (Trialsin) August 25, 2023, 4:06pm 1
Are addons allowed? I’m not seeing an option - perhaps I put them in the wrong folder for hardcore?
[Innverness-2037246](https://us.forums.blizzard.com/en/wow/u/Innverness-2037246) (Innverness) August 25, 2023, 4:11pm 2
Hi Bremon, please be sure that you put them in the _classic_era_ > Interface folder. Fingers crossed for you!
2 Likes

...

Hey there **Bremon** , you need to make sure that the addons aren’t sitting in a second folder.
Ex. ( **Questie** > **Questie** ) - _If it’s somewhat like this, just take the folder(s) out and place them in the location below._
The Blizzard client is sensitive to what it can read and it only goes 1 folder deep.
